result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the two prior blockers and directly touched surfaces. The sweep placeholder is replaced by a real owner-report/owner-requeue implementation, compact embeds sweep by default with sweep:false skip, the obsolete absent receipt literal is removed, and Story 3 coverage now exists in view-sweep.test.ts. Focused tests, story gate, and epic gate all passed.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by code evidence: packages/lhc/src/domains/thread-view/internal/sweep.ts lines 27-41 define the data classification table and unclassified-permanent default; lines 78-135 walk messages.report and turns.report, bucket ready/pending/blocked/failed, requeue transient failures through owner requeue surfaces, count already_queued as in-flight, and assemble SweepReceipt. packages/lhc/src/domains/thread-view/index.ts lines 319-331 run sweep by default during compact with sweep:false skip, lines 469-478 expose standalone sweep, and packages/lhc/src/shared/view.ts lines 122-126 remove the obsolete "absent" receipt literal.

Resolved by test evidence: packages/lhc/test/view-sweep.test.ts covers TC-3.1 at lines 114-181, TC-3.2 at lines 183-198, TC-3.3 schema leg at lines 200-214, classification/blocking/dedupe/unclassified edges at lines 248-379, and TC-3.4 at lines 401-494. Stale placeholder assertions were removed from view-pull.test.ts lines 98-112 and replaced in view-compact.test.ts lines 196-207. Focused view-sweep passed 10 tests; green-verify passed 273 tests with immutability; verify-all passed 300 tests.

verified: AC-3.1: sweep reads state through messages.report and turns.report and requeues through messages.requeue/turns.requeue; no direct work_item/derived_form production access was found in internal/sweep.ts.
AC-3.2: sweep contains no drainSettled/polling/wait loop; TC-3.1 asserts elapsedMs < 1000 and passed.
AC-3.3 and TC-3.1: tests verify ready, pending/in-flight, transient failed, permanent failed, and blocked forms; only transient failure is requeued and provider call count remains unchanged.
AC-3.4 and TC-3.2: repeated sweep without drain reports the requeued form in-flight and leaves exactly one work row; in-walk owner noop dedupe is also tested for shared turn work.
AC-3.5: SweepReceipt lists owner/kind ready, inFlight, requeued, blocked, and permanentFailed with reasons; shared receipt schema test passes.
AC-3.6 and TC-3.4: compact defaults to embedded sweep, sweep:false records { skipped: true }, default compact requeues, background drain heals, and next compact sees the healed form.
AC-3.7 Story 3 scope: standalone SDK sweep returns the shared SweepReceipt shape; CLI execution parity is explicitly deferred to Story 5 by story/test-plan text.
Story hard gate: pre-launch requeue patch and reason-class persistence remain recorded in team-impl-log and are supported by owner requeue/work-queue/FC-0.4 evidence.
Configured story gate and epic gate passed.

additionalObservations: The remaining materialize not_implemented stub is Story 5 scope and was not treated as a Story 3 production-path issue.
